title: I-30 Dallas photo archive
text: The photo archive includes photos which are obsolete due to construction or other changes. These photos show I-30 before upgrades to current conditions.

images.caption: Downtown, looking west from the Houston Street overpass. Just ahead I-30 branches to the left for the Trinity River crossing.

imageStatus.note: The area shown was completely rebuilt with new ramps during the Horseshoe project, completed in 2017. The Margaret Hunt Hill bridge, with long-span arches, replaced the original Trinity River bridge.
The original interchange shown in this photo was demolished in 2022 as part of the LBJ East project. See the LBJ East construction page for photos of demolition in progress.

images.caption: Driver's view westbound on the frontage road approaching the Interstate 635 interchange. The frontage roads penetrate through the interchange.

imageStatus.note: The original interchange shown in this photo was demolished in 2022 for the LBJ East project. See the LBJ East construction page for photos of demolition in progress.

images.caption: Driver's view westbound approaching the I-635 interchange

imageStatus.note: The original interchange shown in this photo was demolished in 2022 for the LBJ East project. See the LBJ East construction page for photos of demolition in progress.

images.caption: At Interstate 635. This interchange opened in 1970 in conjunction with the completion of Interstate 635.

imageStatus.note: The original interchange shown in this photo was demolished in 2022 for the LBJ East project. See the LBJ East construction page for photos of demolition in progress.

images.caption: Looking west from the Zion Road overpass

imageStatus.note: In 2011 a lane was added in each direction and the westbound entrance ramp ahead was removed.

images.caption: Looking west from Horizon Street, with lake Ray Hubbard ahead

imageStatus.note: Main lanes were widened to 4 in each direction and frontage roads on new bridges were added. Work on this section began in March 2023 with completion scheduled for January 2027.

images.caption: Looking west from the DalRock road overpass, which is on a peninsula in Lake Ray Hubbard.

imageStatus.note: Main lanes were widened to 4 in each direction and frontage roads on new bridges were added. A new direct connection ramp from eastbound I-30 to northbound Dalrock was built. Work on this section began in July 2021 with completion in 2025.

images.caption: At Bass Pro Road, looking west.

imageStatus.note: The interchange for the Bush Turnpike was built in the area ahead, opening in 2011. The I-30 main lanes remain about the same.

images.caption: Looking west at Gus Thomasson (west of Interstate 635)

imageStatus.note: This interchange was rebuilt during the LBJ east project. Gus Thomasson previously went over I-30. After construction, I-30 went over Gus Thomasson. Work was substantially complete in 2025.
